# java.maven resolution against a file:// repository of POMs and stand-in
# jars: a parent POM's properties, nearest-wins and first-declared version
# conflicts, exclusions, relocation, JDK profiles, classifiers, and a BOM
# managing versions. The graph beneath com.example:app:
#
#   lib ${lib.version} = 2.0 -> shared 1.0, deep 1.0 -> util 9.0, modern 1.0
#   util 1.0 -> shared 2.0, logging 1.0 (excluded by app)
#   old.group:moved 1.0, relocated to com.example:moved 3.0
[!exec:javac] skip

bit deps managed
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
stdout 'managed ✔ ok'

# com.example:app inherits its version and lib's from its parent.
grep '"com\.example:app": \{\n *"version": "1\.0"' maven.lock.json
grep '"com\.example:lib": \{\n *"version": "2\.0"' maven.lock.json
# lib and util are equally near, so lib's shared, declared first, wins.
grep '"com\.example:shared": \{\n *"version": "1\.0"' maven.lock.json
# util 9.0, deeper beneath deep, loses to util 1.0.
grep '"com\.example:util": \{\n *"version": "1\.0"' maven.lock.json
! grep '9\.0' maven.lock.json
# app excludes logging from util.
! grep 'logging' maven.lock.json
# old.group:moved is relocated to com.example:moved 3.0.
grep '"com\.example:moved": \{\n *"version": "3\.0"' maven.lock.json
! grep 'old\.group' maven.lock.json
# The parent POM is not an artifact of the result.
! grep 'com\.example:parent' maven.lock.json
# lib's profile for JDK 11 and later is active; the one for 1.8 is not.
grep '"com\.example:modern": \{\n *"version": "1\.0"' maven.lock.json
! grep 'legacy' maven.lock.json
# An artifact with a classifier is keyed by it, and its jar was fetched
# from natives-1.0-linux.jar.
grep '"com\.example:natives:jar:linux": \{\n *"version": "1\.0",\n *"sha256"' maven.lock.json

# The BOM fills in lib's version and overrides shared's beneath it.
grep '"com\.example:lib": \{\n *"version": "2\.0"' managed.lock.json
grep '"com\.example:shared": \{\n *"version": "5\.0"' managed.lock.json
! grep 'com\.example:bom"' managed.lock.json

-- BUILD.bit --
deps = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:app:1.0", "com.example:natives:jar:linux:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
}

managed = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:lib"]
  boms         = ["com.example:bom:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
  lock         = "managed.lock.json"
}
-- repo/com/example/parent/1.0/parent-1.0.pom --
<project>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
  <version>1.0</version>
  <packaging>pom</packaging>
  <properties>
    <lib.version>2.0</lib.version>
  </properties>
</project>
-- repo/com/example/app/1.0/app-1.0.pom --
<project>
  <parent>
    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
    <version>1.0</version>
  </parent>
  <artifactId>app</artifactId>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.example</groupId>
      <artifactId>lib</artifactId>
      <version>${lib.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
      <artifactId>util</artifactId>
      <version>1.0</version>
      <exclusions>
        <exclusion>
          <groupId>com.example</groupId>
          <artifactId>logging</artifactId>
        </exclusion>
      </exclusions>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>old.group</groupId>
      <artifactId>moved</artifactId>
      <version>1.0</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</project>
-- repo/com/example/app/1.0/app-1.0.jar --
app
-- repo/com/example/lib/2.0/lib-2.0.pom --
<project>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>lib</artifactId>
  <version>2.0</version>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.example</groupId>
      <artifactId>shared</artifactId>
      <version>1.0</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.example</groupId>
      <artifactId>deep</artifactId>
      <version>1.0</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
  <profiles>
    <profile>
      <activation><jdk>[11,)</jdk></activation>
      <dependencies>
        <dependency>
          <groupId>com.example</groupId>
          <artifactId>modern</artifactId>
          <version>1.0</version>
        </dependency>
      </dependencies>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <activation><jdk>1.8</jdk></activation>
      <dependencies>
        <dependency>
          <groupId>com.example</groupId>
          <artifactId>legacy</artifactId>
          <version>1.0</version>
        </dependency>
      </dependencies>
    </profile>
  </profiles>
</project>
